name: Iran
description: Follow Iran, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Funding milestone detected
changes.summary: The U.S. launched an 11th consecutive night of strikes against Iran on Tuesday. CBS News' Weijia Jiang reports on Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth's earlier testimony about the Pentagon's request for additional funding. Then, Washington Post national security reporter Noah Robertson joins with analysis.

changes.title: What to know about Pickaxe Mountain, an Iranian target noted by Trump
changes.summary: President Trump on Tuesday threatened to attack Pickaxe Mountain in Iran, a secure facility allegedly used for nuclear activity. CBS News national security analyst Aaron MacLean has more.

changes.title: See How Houthis Put the Red Sea at Risk as an Alternative Oil Route
changes.summary: Saudi Arabia has diverted huge amounts of oil to the Red Sea since the Iran war began, but now the Iranian-backed Houthi militants say that they intend to block that route.

changes.title: Funding milestone detected
changes.summary: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth faced a barrage of questions about the war with Iran from lawmakers on Tuesday, as the administration seeks more money for the escalating conflict.

changes.title: Sen. Patty Murray, D-Wash., on Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth's Senate testimony
changes.summary: NPR's Leila Fadel speaks with Democratic Sen. Patty Murray of Washington about the administration's Iran war objectives following the testimony of Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth.

changes.title: U.S. and Iranian attacks continue as tensions mount on a key waterway in the Red Sea
changes.summary: The attacks overshadowed diplomatic efforts in Pakistan, one of the conflict's mediators, where a senior Iranian official held talks potentially aimed at reviving a collapsed ceasefire between the United States and Iran. (Image credit: Atta Kenare).

changes.title: Trump to attend dignified transfer of fallen soldiers. And, Hegseth testifies on Iran
changes.summary: Trump will attend the dignified transfer of U.S. service members killed in the Middle East. And, Pete Hegseth is requesting billions from Congress to help with the rising cost of the war in Iran. (Image credit: Saul Loeb).

changes.title: Funding milestone detected
changes.summary: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth and Chairman of the Joint Chiefs Dan Caine testified Tuesday before a Senate panel to ask for an additional $67 billion to fight the war against Iran. CBS News' Caitlin Huey-Burns has more.

changes.title: With His Latest Threats, Trump Signals to Iran That He Is Willing to Escalate
changes.summary: President Trump is facing a critical moment in the war, which has failed to bring about the “unconditional surrender” he once demanded.

changes.title: Iran’s foreign minister describes moment of attack that killed Khamenei
changes.summary: Abbas Araghchi says he has kept on the move since being pulled from rubble after strike on first day of war Iran’s foreign minister, Abbas Araghchi, has described how he was pulled from the rubble of a leadership compound after the US-Israeli airstrike that killed the country’s supreme leader, Ali Khamenei, on the firs.
